display_long_description:
# Blow away the gang riders on your bike!
[media]
The maximum speed is 180 mph! Watch out for speeding accidents!

# You can smash anything in Gang Town!
[media]
Blow away mailboxes and police cars! Crush the gang riders along the way and recover their illicit funds!

# Roam freely through Gang Town!
[media]
A wide variety of obstacles await! Blast through the dynamic elevation changes at high speed!

Can also be enjoyed as a crash simulator.

# Join The Discord!
[media]
Check our Discord for the latest news, player interactions, and more!

https://mydearest.net/CRASHER-BazookaDiscord
